learning_outcomes.text: Students will gain a historical perspective on human mobility.
Students will be able to review the scientific disciplines working on traffic and the studies conducted.
Students will be able to explain traffic as a system by dividing it into its components.
Students will be able to explain traffic-related laws in terms of obligations.
Students will be able to list the environmental impacts of traffic.
Students will have critically reviewed societal norms related to general life safety and traffic safety.
Students will be able to distinguish the behavioral dynamics of neglect, error, and violation in traffic.
Students will be able to list vulnerable groups in traffic and their characteristics.
Students will be able to list what can be done to ensure the traffic safety of young people.
Students will gain awareness about ensuring their own traffic safety as a young person.

syllabus_topics: Human mobility / development of transportation systems from past to present
What is traffic? What are the basic elements that make up traffic? Traffic problems in the world and in Turkey
Traffic as a multidisciplinary field of study - which disciplines work for traffic order, system - how should multidisciplinary collaboration be? Current situation in Turkey - how does it work?
Traffic and law - traffic law, fundamental rights and obligations perspective on traffic laws
Method in traffic and accident research - information on how scientific research is conducted on traffic
How should traffic areas be arranged? Optimal designs that produce safe behavior - perception - environment and road design and traffic safety
Environmental impacts of traffic (on health - noise, exhaust, stress, crowd, density)
Public transport - alternative modes of transport - examples from the world - rules to be followed
Traffic safety in the context of culture and norms - general life safety - healthy living culture - safety culture
Human factor in traffic - performance and behavior - neglect, error, violation
Concepts of risk and danger - triggers and reinforcing factors of risky behavior - proactive behavior and self-protection skills in traffic
What are the reasons why young people are at risk in traffic?
What is an emergency? Incident scene management, fire, accident. Safety equipment that should be in the vehicle. Courses and addresses where knowledge and skills can be gained
